verdict.rationale: Statsig is a feature-flag and experimentation platform, not an AI agent or host. Plugging external MCP servers in so the product can call their tools is an MCP-client role that falls outside this product category. The evidence documents only Statsig acting as an MCP server (its data MCP and Docs MCP) for other clients such as Cursor and Claude Code. That is the server role and does not make this client axis applicable.
